checks.name: a3-mutation-proof-fails
checks.summary:
A3 temporary-removal proof, mutation NOT committed. With the FailurePromotionPartial constant line temporarily deleted from internal/domain/release.go, `go test ./internal/reconciler` fails at build: '# github.com/takushi/agentic-loop-foundation/v2/internal/reconciler [github.com/takushi/agentic-loop-foundation/v2/internal/reconciler.test]
internal/reconciler/failure_matrix_test.go:165:10: undefined: domain.FailurePromotionPartial
FAIL	github.com/takushi/agentic-loop-foundation/v2/internal/reconciler [build failed]
FAIL'. This is a stronger failure mode than a runtime t.Fatalf: because the updated domainDeclared map in the test references every domain constant by name, removing any one of the 17 constants makes the reconciler test package fail to even compile, so the drift assertion cannot silently pass on a stale expectation (the V2-016 failure mode this task guards against).
